pages.text: Start with steel from your GregTech production line. MFFS recipes accept steel through the shared steel ingredient tag. Open a component in JEI to check the required plates, ingots and other materials.
The Focus Matrix is one of your basic force-field components. Make these as you prepare your machinery.
Follow the machinery recipes in JEI as you build your MFFS setup. Producing steel does not replace the other components required by each machine.
